rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0001
rows.name:
So you're heading for Iira's Core...
One last piece of advice from this
expert adventurer... no, from me.

rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Cross Dana Desert from the capital.
At Lake Alegria, you should see a
narrow forest path nearby.

rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Follow the path and make for
the series of stone pillars
lining a large stairway.

rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0004
rows.name:
There's a gate to the core beyond,
but it's long been sealed. No one
knows what's inside now.

rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Hah... I've been imitating Prince
Adel, who's rumored to be a prodigal,
but it doesn't seem to suit me...

rows.label: tlk70000122_05_msg0006
rows.name:
But you... I believe you'll be able
to save Iira because you truly are
heroes... Please protect this country!
